_comment: devrig artifact coordinates, written at devrig RELEASE time by resolveDevrigCoordinates (so generateInstaller is a pure data-merge with no devrig/plugin build dependency). The sha256 is computed from the :npx-kt distZip — which the release CI uploads verbatim as the GitHub asset IN THE SAME JOB, so the recorded sha matches the published bytes (distZip is not byte-reproducible across machines, hence same-job hash+upload). The zip is universal across platforms; binSubpath is derived by the generator as devrig-<version>/bin/devrig (POSIX) or devrig-<version>/bin/devrig.bat (Windows), matching distributionBaseName=devrig-$version. PLACEHOLDER values below are overwritten by the release task; integration tests supply their own coordinate file pointing at the mock server.
